Help.title: Install the SST Companion for Street Fighter 6
Help.intro: The SST Companion for Street Fighter 6 is an extension for Chrome, Brave or Edge (on PC). It reads your matches from Buckler's Boot Camp in your own browser and sends them to SST. It takes about 5 minutes.
Help.betaNote: During the beta the extension is installed by hand, in “developer mode”. It's temporary: a simpler installation will come later.
Help.downloadMissing: Ask the beta organizer for the Companion ZIP file.
Help.step2: Unzip it into a folder you won't delete (for example, Documents). You should see the manifest.json file inside.
Help.step3: Open the extensions page: copy your browser's address and paste it into the address bar.
Help.step4: Turn on “Developer mode” (top right; in Edge, in the left panel).
Help.step5: Press “Load unpacked” and choose the folder that contains manifest.json.
Help.step6: Pin the extension: puzzle icon 🧩, then the pin 📌 next to SST Companion for Street Fighter 6.
Help.step7: In that same browser, log in to Buckler's Boot Camp.
Help.step8: Come back here and press “Connect Companion” to pair it with your account.
Help.warningTitle: Does the browser show a warning?
Help.warningBody: Chrome may warn that you have extensions in developer mode. That's normal during the beta and doesn't mean something is wrong: choose to keep the extension.
Help.privacyBody: The Companion never sends your Capcom cookies or password, and it doesn't use the browser's cookies permission. It only sends your CFN, your characters with their rank/LP/MR, and your matches.
Help.updateIntro: When the dashboard shows “⚡ New version available”, you don't need to reinstall:
Help.updateStep1: Download the new ZIP (the same download button always gives you the latest version).
Help.updateStep3: Replace the contents of the folder you were already using with the new files (same folder, same place).
Help.updateStep4: Open your browser's extensions page (chrome://extensions, brave://extensions or edge://extensions).
Help.updateStep5: On SST Companion for Street Fighter 6, press ⟳ Reload.
Help.updateStep6: Check that the card shows the new version; the dashboard will show “✓ Companion up to date” after the next sync.
Help.updateStep7: If the Companion shows “Not connected”, generate a new code in the dashboard and pair it again: your sessions are not lost.
